headline: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works stock price drops 80% due to split
summary: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works shares are trading 80% lower today following a stock split. The price adjustment is a technical move to reflect the increased number of shares in circulation. Investors holding the stock will see their share count increase proportionally, maintaining their total investment value. This is a standard corporate action and does not indicate a loss in company valuation.
why_it_matters: Your total investment value remains unchanged despite the lower share price.

headline: Knowledge Marine acquires TSHD River Pearl 48 vessel
hook: Dredging fleet expands for large-scale projects
summary: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works has completed the acquisition of the TSHD River Pearl 48 trailing suction hopper dredger. The vessel is intended to support the company's large-scale maintenance dredging operations. This addition increases the firm's capacity to execute bigger infrastructure contracts. Retail investors should note the potential for increased revenue capacity from expanded fleet capabilities.
why_it_matters: Expanded fleet capacity may drive higher project execution revenue

headline: Knowledge Marine shares jump 4% on Rs 303 crore order and stock split
hook: Dredging contract and stock split announced
summary: Knowledge Marine shares rose 4.17% following a Rs 303.17 crore three-year maintenance dredging contract win from the New Mangalore Port Authority. The company also set a November 6 record date for its upcoming five-for-one stock split. The stock has gained 67% in 2026 so far. Retail investors holding the stock will see their holdings split fivefold ahead of the record date.
why_it_matters: Order win boosts revenue visibility while stock split increases liquidity

headline: Knowledge Marine secures Rs 300 crore dredging order from New Mangalore Port
hook: Major contract win for marine services
summary: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works has bagged a major dredging contract worth Rs 300 crore from the New Mangalore Port. The project covers maintenance dredging across various zones including the outer approach channel, lagoon, dock areas, and turning circle. This large order book addition strengthens the company's operational visibility in the port infrastructure segment. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap maritime stocks should note the revenue pipeline expansion.
whats_next: Project execution updates in upcoming quarterly earnings
why_it_matters: Order book expands significantly for small-cap marine player

headline: Knowledge Marine sets record date for subdivision
hook: Upcoming record date for Knowledge Marine
summary: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Limited has notified the stock exchanges that November 6, 2026, will serve as the record date for its stock subdivision. This corporate action determines which shareholders are eligible for the share split. Retail investors holding the stock as of this date will see their shareholding adjusted according to the subdivision ratio.
why_it_matters: Share count and price adjust per subdivision ratio
